svg.text: NEMA14 CH32X035G8U6 | Motor Driver & Voltage Monitor
A4 landscape | 3 / 3 | Named nets connect across sheets | NC = intentionally unused pin

text.tspan: 3.9k / 1k VREF and 0.24 ohm shunts: 0.351 A nominal.
ENABLE pull-up / SLEEP pull-down keep the driver off.
U_DRV regulates both windings at fixed 1/16 microsteps.
C_CP / C_VCP / C_VREG support the internal driver rails.
Bulk capacitance and TVS limit transients; regeneration needs bench tests.
U_VM_ISO / SN74CBTLV1G125 blocks ADC backfeed when off.
OE pull-up defaults off; MCU enables, waits 0.5 ms, then samples VM/21.
